PingalaPrastara.isPropFib: {f : Pattern → ℕ} {n : ℕ} (p : Pattern) → isProp (f p ≡ n)
PingalaPrastara.isPropFib2:
{n = f : ℕ} {k = n : ℕ} (p : Pattern) →
isProp ((varna p ≡ f) × (guruOf p ≡ n))
PingalaPrastara.matrameruIso: (f : ℕ) → Iso (Metre (suc (suc f))) (Metre (suc f) ⊎ Metre f)
PingalaPrastara.matrameru:
(f : ℕ → ℕ) →
((n : ℕ) → Iso (Metre n) (Fin (f n))) →
(p : ℕ) → f (suc (suc p)) ≡ f (suc p) + f p
PingalaPrastara.matraRecurrence: (f : ℕ) → matra (suc (suc f)) ≡ matra (suc f) + matra f
PingalaPrastara.varna-nasta: (f n : ℕ) → varna (nasta f n) ≡ f
PingalaPrastara.splitTwo: (f : ℕ) → aksara (parity f) + (half f + half f) ≡ f
PingalaPrastara.halfLe: (f : ℕ) → half f + half f ≤ f
PingalaPrastara.halfBound: (f n : ℕ) → n < f + f → half n < f
PingalaPrastara.uddista-nasta: (f n : ℕ) → n < sankhya f → uddista (nasta f n) ≡ n
PingalaPrastara.pascalIso:
(f n : ℕ) →
Iso (Chosen (suc f) (suc n)) (Chosen f (suc n) ⊎ Chosen f n)
